tests.title: Double-clicking Proceed to checkout creates only one order
tests.goal: A customer who clicks Proceed to checkout twice (or on a slow connection) is charged and reserved for one order only.
preconditions: Logged-in QA member, cart empty, promo popup and notification prompt dismissed
data: A non-quota product found at runtime
Bank Transfer (fn-bank-transfer), store pickup 荔枝角

steps.text: Add 1 unit of the product to the cart and open /checkout
Fill the pickup details, select Bank Transfer and tick 結帳前同意
Open My Orders and the CRM order list (filter by the member)

expected.text: Step 3: one thank-you page with one order number; the button is disabled or ignores the second click
Step 4: exactly one new order for the member; the product Available in TaiPo dropped by 1, not 2
Cleanup: void the order in the CRM
